question: Can an operator run the complete Base/effect evidence pipeline in shadow mode from a strict manifest and an existing journaled attempt, while deterministic conformance scenarios prove every terminal outcome without exposing any action path?
startingState: Base collection, signed effect verification, immutable artifacts, and journal-bound v0.2 closure are individually implemented and verified, but no single orchestrator or operator CLI composes them and no end-to-end scenario matrix exercises the composed boundary.
boundedChange: Add a strict shadow-run manifest and orchestration library, an explicit operator CLI that resolves only registry-pinned read-only Base RPC endpoints, verifies optional file-supplied effect attestations against out-of-band pins, requires an existing journaled attempt, writes only private evidence artifacts/journal commits, emits a sanitized closure result, and add a deterministic injected conformance matrix. No operation execution, authorization creation/signing/transmission, retry, wallet, payment, public route, deployment, scheduler, or arbitrary URL input.
successCondition: One command can close or exactly replay a no-action v0.2 bundle from an existing controlled attempt; all runtime authority brands are created in-process; strict config, registry, journal, operation, authorization, timestamp, and output redaction checks fail closed; deterministic scenarios cover absent, confirmed, pending, contradiction, duplicate, effect unknown/committed/absent, replay, and malformed inputs; every execution flag remains false.
failureCondition: The runner creates or transmits an authorization, invokes a write/signing/payment/action method, accepts raw authority observations or a missing/mismatched journal attempt, leaks endpoint credentials, accepts arbitrary RPC URLs, turns unknown evidence into a retry action, or emits a closure that does not pass offline integrity verification.
requiredReceipts: End-to-end shadow scenario and redaction matrix

events.note: Require an existing pinned journal attempt; the runner never appends attempt or authorization lifecycle events and exposes no action path.
Reject Base collections that are not kernel_ready before artifact publication or kernel commits; a receipt beyond the finalized anchor cannot become absence.
Require canonical registry representations and process-local brands for both derived intents and integrity-verified public results, preventing replay relabeling and fabricated verified output.
Exact replay verifies the retained journal/artifact graph and current manifest hashes without consulting the clock or RPC; it does not claim fresh transport or signature authentication.
Independent runner no-action/security review PASS after replay, lifecycle, branding, readiness, transport, network-sink, and redaction fixes.

events.note: End-to-end shadow scenario, redaction, malformed-input, lifecycle, replay, and lower-level readiness matrix passed in the full deterministic repository suite.
Static and compiled release gates passed after the final production changes.
